scopeHash.algorithm: SHA256(canonical JSON of complete plan with exactly the three named slots replaced by null); object keys sorted, array order preserved
noOwnHashOrFutureOutputPinsInPlan: state15 output hash or future publication receipt pin
scopeHash.oldSourceDigestAlgorithmsUnchanged: Original source/helper pins retain their existing JSON.stringify-array digest preimage; canonical plan hashing does not redefine historical digests

preconditions: actual fresh15 state-free dual139x2 equivalent to final14
candidateStage.input: Immutable candidate plan with all three named slots null
candidateStage.approval: Separate CLI pin: Root-authorized-source15-bootstrap-only exact G2 binds candidate input raw pin and computed scope; no publication/state/context/domain permission
candidateStage.B0: Actual wx written/readback Source15 bootstrap candidate; contains scope hash, actual tuple, candidateInput pin and bootstrap-only exact G2 pin; contains no future Reg5/B1/state pin
candidateStage.fill: Only after B0 really exists fill consumer.bootstrapCandidate; scope hash remains identical

finalReview.independentReview: Binds exact scope, actual B0 pin, code/tooling closure, parent14 and new actual tuple; publication verdict explicit
finalReview.RootExecutionApproval: Binds same scope, same actual B0, exact independentReview pin, allowed publish mode and new15-state absence
finalReview.slotExclusionIsNotValidationWaiver: Native verifier reads/validates all three excluded-slot artifacts. B0 swap under same scope still fails exact review/B0 equality and derived-body validation
finalReview.finalPlan: Fill review/approval pins then freeze complete immutable raw plan. Neither review references this eventual full-plan raw hash, avoiding a cycle

publicationOrder: Pre-import exact H3/external code checks, real all facts/Root exact G2, private nonce lock; require no prior state15 or ambiguous publication
Write and read back immutable Reg5, referencing final approved-plan pin and actual B0; Reg5 contains no B1/state raw hash
Derive, write and read back actual B1 using real Reg5/B0/current tuple; B1 contains no state raw hash
Build initial state15 referencing actual Reg5 and actual B1; stage privately, verify full transfer/body, atomically publish state15 as final activation point
Record complete publication receipt with real output pins and state hash, then require independent readback before any separate business G2
B1Mode: B1 CLI mode verifies/returns the already physically written B1; does not create a second admitted candidate
ordinaryAdmission: Requires state15 plus matching actual Reg5/B1 and all native current bindings. Orphan Reg5/B1 before atomic state is not ordinary admission
interruption: Keep intent/staged/orphan files and every original; do not overwrite or rerun publish. Inspect exact known paths and reconcile actual outcome read-only under new Root approval
